cards/starter-csse7030-01.back:
[2, 5, 8]
range(start, stop, step)：從 2 開始每次 +3，不包含 10。

cards/starter-csse7030-02.front: What is the difference between a list and a tuple in Python?
cards/starter-csse7030-02.back:
A list is mutable (it can be changed); a tuple is immutable.
list 可以改、tuple 不能改；tuple 可以當 dict 的 key。

cards/starter-csse7030-03.front: What does a function return if it has no return statement?
cards/starter-csse7030-03.back:
None.
沒有 return 的函式會回傳 None。

cards/starter-csse7030-04.back:
3 1 3.5
// 整數除法、% 餘數、/ 一般除法（結果是 float）。

cards/starter-csse7030-05.back:
yth n
[1:4] 取索引 1、2、3（不含 4）；-1 是最後一個字元。

cards/starter-csse7030-06.front: What does d.get(key, default) do for a dictionary d?
cards/starter-csse7030-06.back:
It returns d[key] if the key exists, otherwise default, without raising KeyError.
找不到 key 時回傳預設值，不會報錯。

cards/starter-csse7030-07.back:
None
list.sort() 原地排序並回傳 None；要新的排序 list 用 sorted(nums)。

cards/starter-csse7030-08.front: What is the difference between == and is?
cards/starter-csse7030-08.back:
== compares values; is checks whether two names refer to the same object.
== 比較值，is 比較是不是同一個物件。

cards/starter-csse7030-09.front: In a class, what is self?
cards/starter-csse7030-09.back:
The first parameter of an instance method; it refers to the object the method was called on.
self 代表呼叫這個方法的物件本身。

cards/starter-csse7030-10.back:
It initialises a new object: it runs when the object is created and sets its attributes.
建立物件時自動執行，用來設定屬性的初始值。

cards/starter-csse7030-11.front: What is MVC in GUI programming?
cards/starter-csse7030-11.back:
Model–View–Controller: the model holds data and logic, the view displays it, the controller handles user input and updates both.
Model 管資料、View 管畫面、Controller 處理使用者操作。

cards/starter-csse7030-12.back:
[1, 2, 3]
y = x 沒有複製 list，x 和 y 指向同一個物件（aliasing）。

cards/starter-math7861-01.front: What is the contrapositive of p → q? Is it equivalent to p → q?
cards/starter-math7861-01.back:
¬q → ¬p. Yes, it is logically equivalent.
逆否命題和原命題等價；逆命題 q → p 則不一定。

cards/starter-math7861-02.back:
∃x ¬P(x).
「所有 x 都成立」的否定是「存在一個 x 不成立」。

cards/starter-math7861-03.back:
A compound proposition that is true for every truth assignment, e.g. p ∨ ¬p.
恆真式：不論真假值怎麼給都為真。

cards/starter-math7861-04.front: What are the steps of a proof by mathematical induction?
cards/starter-math7861-04.back:
1) Base case: prove P(n₀). 2) Inductive step: assume P(k) and prove P(k + 1). Then P(n) holds for all n ≥ n₀.
基礎步驟＋歸納步驟（假設 P(k) 成立，證明 P(k+1)）。

cards/starter-math7861-05.back:
If n + 1 or more objects are placed into n boxes, some box contains at least two objects.
鴿籠原理。

cards/starter-math7861-06.back:
|A| + |B| − |A ∩ B|
排容原理：交集被算了兩次，要減掉一次。

cards/starter-math7861-07.front: How many r-combinations of n objects are there, C(n, r)?
cards/starter-math7861-07.back:
n! / (r! (n − r)!)
不考慮順序的選法數。

cards/starter-math7861-08.front: Which three properties make a relation an equivalence relation?
cards/starter-math7861-08.back:
Reflexive, symmetric and transitive.
自反、對稱、遞移。

cards/starter-math7861-09.front: What does a ≡ b (mod n) mean?
cards/starter-math7861-09.back:
n divides a − b; equivalently, a and b leave the same remainder when divided by n.
a 和 b 除以 n 的餘數相同。

cards/starter-math7861-10.back:
In any graph, the sum of the vertex degrees equals 2|E|. So the number of odd-degree vertices is even.
握手定理。

cards/starter-math7861-11.front: When does a connected graph have an Euler circuit?
cards/starter-math7861-11.back:
When every vertex has even degree.
連通圖，且每個頂點的度數都是偶數。

cards/starter-math7861-12.front: Define injective, surjective and bijective functions.
cards/starter-math7861-12.back:
Injective: different inputs give different outputs. Surjective: every element of the codomain is an output. Bijective: both.
一對一、映成、一一對應。

cards/starter-math7861-13.back:
A set with a binary operation that is closed and associative, has an identity element, and in which every element has an inverse.
封閉、結合律、單位元素、反元素。

cards/starter-cybr7001-01.back:
機密性、完整性、可用性
Confidentiality, integrity and availability: the three core goals of information security.

extra.def: Confidentiality, integrity and availability: the three core goals of information security.
extra.example: A ransomware attack mainly harms availability.

cards/starter-cybr7001-02.front: What is the difference between a threat, a vulnerability and a risk?
cards/starter-cybr7001-02.back:
Threat: something that could cause harm. Vulnerability: a weakness that could be exploited. Risk: the likelihood and impact of a threat exploiting a vulnerability.
威脅、弱點、風險；風險 ≈ 可能性 × 影響。

cards/starter-cybr7001-03.back:
威脅行為者
A person or group that carries out an attack, e.g. nation-states, cybercriminals, hacktivists, insiders.

extra.def: A person or group that carries out an attack, e.g. nation-states, cybercriminals, hacktivists, insiders.
extra.example: A disgruntled employee can be an insider threat actor.

cards/starter-cybr7001-04.back:
縱深防禦
Several layers of security controls, so if one fails the others still protect the asset.

extra.def: Several layers of security controls, so if one fails the others still protect the asset.
extra.example: A firewall, MFA and offline backups together are defence in depth.

cards/starter-cybr7001-05.back:
社交工程
Manipulating people into giving information or access instead of attacking technology.

extra.def: Manipulating people into giving information or access instead of attacking technology.
extra.example: A fake IT support call asking for your password.

cards/starter-cybr7001-06.back:
最小權限原則
Give users and programs only the access they need for their job.

extra.def: Give users and programs only the access they need for their job.
extra.example: An intern should not have administrator rights.

cards/starter-cybr7001-07.front: What are the ASD Essential Eight?
cards/starter-cybr7001-07.back:
Application control, patch applications, configure Microsoft Office macro settings, user application hardening, restrict administrative privileges, patch operating systems, multi-factor authentication, regular backups.
澳洲訊號局（ASD）建議的八項基本防護策略。

cards/starter-cybr7001-08.front: What is Australia's Notifiable Data Breaches (NDB) scheme?
cards/starter-cybr7001-08.back:
Under the Privacy Act 1988, covered organisations must notify affected individuals and the OAIC when a data breach is likely to cause serious harm.
可能造成嚴重傷害的資料外洩，必須通知當事人和 OAIC。

cards/starter-cybr7001-09.back:
零時差漏洞
A flaw that the vendor does not know about yet, so no patch exists.

extra.def: A flaw that the vendor does not know about yet, so no patch exists.
extra.example: Attackers used the zero-day before a fix was released.

cards/starter-cybr7001-10.back:
勒索軟體
Malware that encrypts or steals data and demands payment.

extra.def: Malware that encrypts or steals data and demands payment.
extra.example: Ransomware can stop a hospital from opening patient records.

cards/starter-cybr7001-11.front: Why is attributing a cyber attack difficult?
cards/starter-cybr7001-11.back:
Attackers use proxies, compromised machines and false flags, and evidence crosses national borders, so it is hard to prove who is responsible.
攻擊者會用跳板、偽旗和跨國設施，很難證明是誰做的。

cards/starter-cybr7001-12.back:
攻擊面
All the points where an attacker could try to enter a system or take data out.

extra.def: All the points where an attacker could try to enter a system or take data out.
extra.example: Every new internet-facing service increases the attack surface.

cards/starter-cybr7002-01.front: What are the three types of authentication factor?
cards/starter-cybr7002-01.back:
Something you know (password), something you have (phone, token), something you are (biometrics). MFA combines two or more different types.
知道的、擁有的、本身的特徵；MFA 要組合不同類型。

cards/starter-cybr7002-02.back:
誤接受率／誤拒絕率
FAR: impostors wrongly accepted. FRR: genuine users wrongly rejected. Lowering one usually raises the other; the EER is where they are equal.

extra.def: FAR: impostors wrongly accepted. FRR: genuine users wrongly rejected. The EER is where they are equal.
extra.example: A very strict fingerprint reader has a low FAR but a higher FRR.

cards/starter-cybr7002-03.back:
Symmetric uses one shared secret key (fast, e.g. AES). Asymmetric uses a public/private key pair (slower, e.g. RSA), which solves key distribution and enables digital signatures.
對稱：同一把鑰匙；非對稱：公鑰與私鑰。

cards/starter-cybr7002-04.front: Which properties should a cryptographic hash function have?
cards/starter-cybr7002-04.back:
Pre-image resistance (one-way), second pre-image resistance and collision resistance; a small input change gives a very different output.
單向、抗第二原像、抗碰撞。

cards/starter-cybr7002-05.front: How does a digital signature work?
cards/starter-cybr7002-05.back:
The sender signs a hash of the message with their private key; anyone can verify it with the sender's public key. It gives integrity, authentication and non-repudiation.
用私鑰簽、公鑰驗；提供完整性、身分驗證、不可否認。

cards/starter-cybr7002-06.back:
Identification: claiming who you are. Authentication: proving it. Authorisation: what you are allowed to do.
識別、驗證、授權。

cards/starter-cybr7002-07.back:
網路釣魚／魚叉式釣魚／捕鯨
Phishing targets many people; spear phishing targets a specific person or group; whaling targets senior executives.

extra.zh: 網路釣魚／魚叉式釣魚／捕鯨
extra.def: Phishing targets many people; spear phishing targets specific people; whaling targets senior executives.
extra.example: An email pretending to be the CEO asks finance to pay an invoice.

cards/starter-cybr7002-08.back:
支付卡產業資料安全標準
Security requirements for organisations that store, process or transmit cardholder data.

extra.zh: 支付卡產業資料安全標準
extra.def: Security requirements for organisations that store, process or transmit cardholder data.
extra.example: An online shop must protect stored card numbers under PCI DSS.

cards/starter-cybr7002-09.front: What is the cloud shared responsibility model?
cards/starter-cybr7002-09.back:
The provider secures the cloud infrastructure; the customer secures what they put in it (data, identities, configuration). The split depends on IaaS, PaaS or SaaS.
雲端業者負責雲本身，客戶負責雲裡的資料與設定。

cards/starter-cybr7002-10.back:
An IDS detects suspicious traffic and alerts; an IPS sits inline and can block it automatically.
IDS 偵測並告警，IPS 可以直接阻擋。

cards/starter-cybr7002-11.front: Why is availability usually the top priority in industrial control systems?
cards/starter-cybr7002-11.back:
ICS run physical processes such as power and water; downtime can endanger safety and is very costly, and the systems are old and hard to patch.
工控系統停機會影響安全與民生，所以可用性優先。

cards/starter-cybr7002-12.back:
職責分離
Splitting a critical task between people so no single person can misuse it.

extra.def: Splitting a critical task between people so no single person can misuse it.
extra.example: One staff member creates a payment and another approves it.

cards/starter-cybr7002-13.front: What is WPA3's main improvement over WPA2-Personal?
cards/starter-cybr7002-13.back:
WPA3 replaces the pre-shared-key handshake with SAE, which resists offline password-guessing and provides forward secrecy.
WPA3 改用 SAE，能抵抗離線字典攻擊。
